hints.title: Identify Actual Group Size
hints.text: Count the actual number of available nodes in the current group before deciding whether to reverse.

hints.title: Conditional Reversal
hints.text: Reverse the node connections if and only if the actual group length is an even number.

hints.title: Pointer Re-stitching
hints.text: Maintain pointers to the end of the previous group and start of the next group for seamless list reconnection.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def reverseEvenLengthGroups(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        prev_group_tail = None
        curr = head
        group_len = 1

        while curr:
            count = 0
            temp = curr
            while temp and count < group_len:
                count += 1
                temp = temp.next

            if count % 2 == 0:
                rev_prev = None
                rev_curr = curr
                for _ in range(count):
                    nxt = rev_curr.next
                    rev_curr.next = rev_prev
                    rev_prev = rev_curr
                    rev_curr = nxt

                if prev_group_tail:
                    prev_group_tail.next = rev_prev
                curr.next = rev_curr
                prev_group_tail = curr
                curr = rev_curr
            else:
                for _ in range(count):
                    prev_group_tail = curr
                    curr = curr.next

            group_len += 1

        return head
```

complexity.time: O(N) traversal and selective group reversal
variables: N: number of nodes in list
complexity.notes: Groups have nominal sizes 1, 2, 3, ... with the last group taking remaining nodes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reversing based on nominal group size instead of actual node count breaks for the terminal group.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting actual nodes first ensures reversal happens if and only if actual size is even.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should count actual group size before deciding whether to reverse pointers.
